data.raw_text:
[9:23PM] #Ogolonto #TrafficUpdate 

Smooth traffic flow from Itanwolo inward Majindu, although a minor delay is experienced approaching Ogoloto intersection due to traffic interchange. However, immediately after Ogoloto, traffic movement improves significantly inward Agric and continues through to Haruno. 
A similar smooth movement is observed on the return journey from Haruno to Itanwolo.
Good traffic movement on the route connecting Ogoloto to Obasekumade, inward Ferry Terminal, encompassing Ebute Police Post, General Hospital, Ojogbe, Ita Elewa, and environs.
Unencumbered traffic flow from Ebute inward Ibese Roundabout, down to Igbogbo, with no notable congestion.

#FollowLASTMA

data.raw_text:
[9:36PM] #Badagry #TrafficUpdate 

Steady and smooth vehicular movement observed from Badagry Roundabout, connecting Joseph Dosu Way, down to Badagry Market, with traffic flowing optimally.
Unimpeded traffic flow on the return journey from Badagry Market to Badagry Roundabout, encompassing Ibereko, Aradagun, Mowo, Age Mowo, Elijah, Ile Epo, en route Oko Afo, down to Magbon, Ibiye Odofa, Morogbo, and back to Agbara, with both outbound and return journeys experiencing fluid movement.

#FollowLASTMA
